Service

Fauna Spotter Catcher Services

Onsite snake and fauna capture and relocation for construction, infrastructure, mining and environmental works.

Clearing, earthworks and construction disturb wildlife — and bring snakes and other fauna into contact with your crew. Our licensed spotter catchers work ahead of and alongside machinery to find, capture and relocate animals so works stay safe, compliant and moving.

What’s included

  • Pre-clearing fauna surveys and inspection of hollows, logs and burrows
  • Spotter catchers working alongside clearing and earthworks crews
  • Safe capture and relocation of snakes, lizards, frogs, birds and mammals
  • Call-out response to snakes in site offices, crib rooms and plant
  • Fauna handling records and reports to support your environmental approvals

When you need it

Vegetation clearing, grubbing and bulk earthworks

Road, rail, pipeline, transmission and other linear infrastructure

Mine site expansions, rehabilitation and camp works

Projects whose environmental approvals require a fauna spotter catcher

How it works

  1. 1Survey

    Pre-clearing check of hollows, logs and burrows.

  2. 2Lead

    Spotter works ahead of and beside machinery.

  3. 3Capture

    Safe capture of snakes and other fauna.

  4. 4Relocate

    Release into suitable nearby habitat.

  5. 5Record

    Encounter records for your approvals.
